scriptComments: The script is so massive, Scratch will not render it all. I had to break it up to build it, the put it back together. However, that was in the old scratch engine. It renders properly in scratch 2.0
this is a block of debugging code that I use to access the player start version that I am still working on.
This is the code that runs when the player starts.This part of the code is a work-in-progress, and cannot normally be accessed in-game. Once it is done, I will add a "player goes first" option.

costumes.text: Sorry! You lost!      But don't feel down. This AI is extremely intelligent, and was hard to        program. So please LOVE-IT!
Cat's game! You tied!That's as close as you'll get to winning        with this AI! Please LOVE-IT!
Oops!Seems like you didn't click in the center of the space. Just restart, then LOVE-IT!

info.comment: This is my first AI, so please love it. It is a simple Tic-Tac-Toe AI that you will lose to almost every time, unless you are good, then you will tie. The computer starts every time, because when I attempted to create the player starts script, it got so big, that Scratch would crash while I was trying to make the script. Have fun, report any glitches, and please LOVE-IT!
